authorSelfScore.scorer: author self-score (the authoring agent; not the independent score create-rigged-character-assets requires)
gaps: The sun core's glowing area now matches the concept's size, but its colour reads peach to salmon rather than hot orange with a yellow-white centre: at the project's GLOW_STRENGTH 0.7 convention AgX desaturates F08C2C, in both the Blender compare and the engine shots.

The head follows the concept's mask layout (brow-panel seams narrowing to the crown, round glowing eyes in dark sockets, cheek seams, a mouth slit over a chin plate) as seams on a smooth lofted helm; the concept's sculpted relief, with deep cheek recesses and a raised brow plate, is not modelled.

The cuirass now reads as inner core-framing panels and outer pectorals parted by gunmetal seams, but the panels carry no engraved lines and stay dimmer face-on than the concept's bright chest (polished brass mirrors the dark background under the frontal key).
Engraving is limited to the skirt tassets (gunmetal border grooves); the pauldrons, vambraces and greaves have no panel lines or rivets.
The front skirt still reads brighter and paler than the concept's bronze under the frontal key, though the tassets separate with dark gaps, a centre slit and engraved borders.

Greaves are faceted brass shields with one gunmetal strap, slightly wider than the concept's slim segmented greaves; sabatons are lofted shells with ankle cops, simpler than the concept's layered, pointed sabatons.
Arms read as smooth tubes with gunmetal bands; gauntlets are blocky (box palm, tube fingers) beside the concept's sculpted hands.
Orbit band placement compromises between views: from the side it swings about 0.4 m in front of the chest, where the concept's side view keeps it behind the shoulders.
The outer halo ring and back skirt read cream under the back key.
In the death pose the folded orbit band intersects the halo rings on the floor.
authorSelfScore.method: Author self-score from orrery-warden.fidelity-compare.jpg: orthographic EEVEE renders of the low-poly model at the concept's front, side and back angles, framed at the concept's own scale (2.70 m over the crop height, 2.66 mm per sheet pixel), judged side by side and in zoomed crops of the head, chest, core, skirt, legs and feet, plus the five in-engine clip shots in staging/engine. Proportions (chest and waist widths, belt and hem heights, pauldron span, ring radii and centre, orbit band tilt and planet positions, and the glowing core's diameter of about 0.165 m) were measured on the concept front view at the same framing. The concept's three views disagree with each other (the back view mirrors the planets, the side view puts the band behind the shoulders), so the model follows the front view. The compare lighting is the fixed shared rig and was not tuned to the score; a throwaway shadows-off diagnostic render (not shipped) showed the chest's dimness comes from plate orientation, not shadowing.

independentScore.scorer: independent reviewer agent (separate from the authoring agent; did not build the model)

rubric.note: Unchanged geometry, so unchanged score. The two halo rings, the tilted orbit band and the long tasset skirt give the right outline. Below the skirt the concept's slim, segmented greaves and pointed sabatons are wide faceted brass blocks with one strap and rounded shell feet, the arms are plain tubes with box-palm hands and the pauldrons are domes, so the tapered figure turns stocky. In the side view the orbit band sits about 0.4 m in front of the chest where the concept keeps it behind the shoulders.

All present: two halo rings, the orbit band with ruby, sapphire and emerald planets, shoulder jewels, the eclipse disc and the sun core. The core now reads as a hot light, a yellow centre (252,222,84) ramping to an amber rim (241,153,47), with a short amber slot below it and amber waist slits, and the eyes are lit amber. Still short of the concept: the core is a round disc in a bezel rather than the concept's keyhole-shaped core with glow bleeding down the abdomen, and the head is a smooth helm with seam lines rather than the sculpted mask.

Unchanged. The plates separate and the skirt tassets carry gunmetal border grooves. The cuirass, pauldrons, vambraces and greaves are smooth with no engraved panel lines or rivets, the brushed streak texture still looks stretched on the skirt, and the head has seams but none of the concept's cheek recesses or raised brow plate.

Glow measured as sRGB from p6-glow-orrery-warden.jpg: core glow median (244,165,65) against the concept core median (242,177,71), core centre (252,222,84) against the concept's near-white peak (255,252,198), eyes (245,183,64) against the concept eyes (247,196,75). Hue and saturation now match the concept and the art bible's candle amber, though the centre stays saturated yellow rather than white-hot. The planets keep correct jewel tones. The brass is still brighter and yellower than the concept's darker bronze, the front skirt goes pale gold under the frontal key, and the outer ring and back skirt go cream in the back renders.

In the new idle shot the core is the brightest, most saturated point on the figure and reads as the focal light against the polished brass. The halo and planets still separate the Warden from the Sentry and the other automatons. Poses read clearly in the older attack, hit and frozen clip shots; in the death pose the folded orbit band intersects the halo rings on the floor.

topFixes: Slim the lower legs into tapered, segmented greaves with layered, pointed sabatons, and replace the box-palm hands with sculpted gauntlets, to restore the concept's slender silhouette.

Add engraved panel lines and rivets to the cuirass, pauldrons, vambraces and greaves, and sculpt the mask relief (raised brow plate, cheek recesses), so the plates read as the concept's detailed armour rather than smooth shells.

Pull the brass toward the concept's darker bronze, especially the pale front skirt and the cream back ring and skirt, and reshape the core from a round disc into the concept's keyhole with a white-hot centre and glow running down the abdomen.
independentScore.method: Re-score after the glow fix (commit ab14b81, geometry unchanged), using the same five-criterion rubric as the previous independent score of 72 so the two compare. Judged the concept sheet at native resolution (the stray Sentry artifact ignored) against the front, side and back orthographic fidelity compare (front and lower-leg panels cropped and enlarged with Pillow), the low-poly Blender renders, the review sheet, the new in-engine idle shot p6-glow-orrery-warden.jpg and the orrery-warden row of p6-glow-before-after.jpg. Glow colour was measured as sRGB with Pillow and NumPy: the median of warm saturated pixels (R over 200, R minus B over 80) in the core and eye regions of the new engine shot and of the concept front view, plus a 9 by 9 sample at the core centre. The Blender compare and renders still show the old peach core, so colour was judged on the new engine shots only, and the older staging/engine clip shots were used for pose readability only. Art bible palette (candle amber F3BE65 for cores and eyes, polished brass DEC16A) checked in docs/art-bible.md.
